import { CrucibleBehaviour, Subsystem } from "@trioforge/crucible";
export abstract class Zone<Tag extends string> extends CrucibleBehaviour<Tag, BasePart> {}
export abstract class Releasing<Tag extends string> extends CrucibleBehaviour<Tag, BasePart> {
	protected stepping?: RBXScriptConnection;
	onDestroy() { this.stepping?.Disconnect(); }
}
export abstract class Store extends Subsystem {}
